risks.risk: The printer may have high page count or be near its end-of-life cycle.
risks.proof: A photo of the 'page count' or 'page count history' screen showing the total number of pages printed.
risks.if_unproven: as having a high page count

Video of the printer powering on and printing a test page.
Photo of the toner cartridge installed and the toner level indicator.
Photo of the 'page count' screen showing the total number of pages printed.
